name: NOIR — Smart Responsive Portfolio
description: An ultra-smart, fully responsive dark-themed portfolio template with fluid typography and bulletproof layout structures.

variables.hero_desc: A refined digital space for your work, ideas, story, and everything that represents you.
variables.work_desc: Showcase projects, experiences, achievements, creations, or anything that represents your journey.
variables.about_desc: Use this space to introduce yourself. Talk about your experience, interests, journey, achievements, or anything that makes your work unique.
variables.contact_desc: Have an idea, opportunity, question, or simply want to say hello? My inbox is always open.

html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>{{page_title}}</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;1,400;1,600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.2/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg: {{hero_bg_color}};
            --bg-soft: #0d0d0d;
            --card: #111111;
            --white: {{hero_text_color}};
            --muted: #777;
            --muted-light: #999;
            --gold: {{gold_color}};
            --accent: {{accent_color}};
            --line: rgba(255,255,255,.09);
            --container: 1240px;
            --ease: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
        }
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
        body {
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--white);
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            width: 100%;
            cursor: default;
            padding: 0 10px;
        }
        a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
        button { font: inherit; color: inherit; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
        .container { width: min(90%, var(--container)); margin-inline: auto; }
        .eyebrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 13px;
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: clamp(9px, 0.9vw, 11px);
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .eyebrow-line {
            width: 32px;
            height: 1px;
            background: currentColor;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            display: inline-block;
        }
        .gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .accent { color: var(--accent); }
        .cursor, .cursor-ring {
            position: fixed;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 99999;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            display: none;
        }
        @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) {
            .cursor {
                display: block;
                width: 8px;
                height: 8px;
                background: var(--gold);
                border-radius: 50%;
                transition: width .35s var(--ease), height .35s var(--ease);
            }
            .cursor-ring {
                display: block;
                width: 34px;
                height: 34px;
                border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.55);
                border-radius: 50%;
                transition: width .4s var(--ease), height .4s var(--ease), border-color .3s ease;
            }
            body.cursor-hover .cursor { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
            body.cursor-hover .cursor-ring { width: 55px; height: 55px; border-color: var(--gold); }
        }
        body::after {
            content: "";
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 9990;
            opacity: .025;
            background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.7'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
        }
        .navbar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 1000;
            padding: 24px 20px;
            transition: padding .6s var(--ease), background .6s ease, border .6s ease;
        }
        .navbar.scrolled {
            padding: 14px 20px;
            background: rgba(7,7,7,.88);
            backdrop-filter: blur(22px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        }
        .nav {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: var(--container);
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .logo {
            font-size: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 19px);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 5px;
        }
        .logo span { color: var(--gold); }
        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 38px);
            list-style: none;
        }
        .nav-links a {
            position: relative;
            color: #888;
            font-size: clamp(12px, 0.9vw, 13px);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            transition: color .3s ease;
        }
        .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--white); }
        .nav-links a::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -5px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--gold);
            transition: width .5s var(--ease);
        }
        .nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }
        .menu-toggle {
            display: none;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--white);
            background: none;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 5px;
        }
        .hero {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 100vh;
            min-height: 100svh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: 120px 0 60px;
        }
        .hero-glow {
            position: absolute;
            width: 500px;
            height: 500px;
            top: 15%;
            right: -200px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(201,168,76,.04);
            filter: blur(100px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            width: 100%;
        }
        .hero-top {
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            animation: fadeUp .9s .15s var(--ease) forwards;
        }
        .hero-title {
            width: 100%;
            font-size: clamp(38px, 8vw, 120px);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: clamp(-2px, -0.5vw, -4px);
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            word-break: break-word;
        }
        .hero-line { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding-bottom: 6px; }
        .hero-word {
            display: inline-block;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(110%);
            animation: titleReveal 1.15s var(--ease) forwards;
            padding-right: 10px;
        }
        .hero-line:nth-child(1) .hero-word { animation-delay: .25s; }
        .hero-line:nth-child(2) .hero-word { animation-delay: .4s; }
        .hero-line:nth-child(3) .hero-word { animation-delay: .55s; }
        .hero-bottom {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 30px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .hero-description {
            max-width: 430px;
            color: #777;
            font-size: clamp(13px, 1.1vw, 15px);
            line-height: 1.8;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeUp .9s .85s var(--ease) forwards;
        }
        .hero-cta {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
            padding: 10px 0;
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: clamp(12px, 1vw, 13px);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeUp .9s 1s var(--ease) forwards;
        }
        .cta-circle {
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            border: 1px solid #444;
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            transition: background .4s ease, border-color .4s ease, transform .5s var(--ease);
        }
        .hero-cta:hover .cta-circle {
            background: var(--gold);
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--bg);
            transform: rotate(-45deg);
        }
        .hero-index {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 30px;
            right: 5%;
            color: #444;
            font-size: 10px;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
        }
        .work {
            background: var(--bg-soft);
            padding: clamp(70px, 10vw, 140px) 0;
        }
        .work-header {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
            gap: 40px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
        }
        .work-title {
            font-size: clamp(34px, 6.5vw, 85px);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: .95;
            letter-spacing: clamp(-2px, -0.4vw, -4px);
            word-break: break-word;
        }
        .work-title .outline {
            color: transparent;
            -webkit-text-stroke: 1px #555;
            transition: color .5s ease;
        }
        .work-title:hover .outline {
            color: var(--gold);
            -webkit-text-stroke-color: var(--gold);
        }
        .work-description {
            max-width: 480px;
            color: #666;
            font-size: clamp(13px, 1.1vw, 14px);
            line-height: 1.9;
        }
        .projects {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
            border-top: none;
            padding-top: 20px;
        }
        .project-card {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: transform .4s var(--ease), box-shadow .4s var(--ease);
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
        }
        .project-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
        }
        .project-card .card-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 180px;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
            background: var(--bg);
        }
        .project-card .card-image-placeholder {
            width: 100%;
            height: 180px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: #444;
            font-size: 2rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        }
        .project-card .card-body {
            padding: 16px 18px 20px;
        }
        .project-card .card-title {
            font-size: clamp(16px, 1.2vw, 20px);
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: var(--white);
        }
        .project-card .card-desc {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: clamp(11px, 0.8vw, 13px);
            line-height: 1.6;
            display: -webkit-box;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .project-card .card-category {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 9px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--gold);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
            padding: 2px 12px;
            border-radius: 20px;
        }
        .card-delete-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            right: 8px;
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            color: #ff6b6b;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            z-index: 5;
            font-size: 12px;
            opacity: 0;
        }
        .project-card:hover .card-delete-btn {
            opacity: 1;
        }
        .card-delete-btn:hover {
            background: #ff6b6b;
            color: #fff;
            border-color: #ff6b6b;
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }
        .add-project-card {
            background: transparent;
            border: 2px dashed rgba(201,168,76,0.25);
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-height: 220px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: border-color .4s ease, background .4s ease;
        }
        .add-project-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            background: rgba(201,168,76,0.04);
        }
        .add-project-card .add-content {
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--muted);
        }
        .add-project-card .add-content i {
            font-size: 2rem;
            color: var(--gold);
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .add-project-card .add-content span {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        .about {
            padding: clamp(70px, 10vw, 140px) 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        }
        .about-content { max-width: 1050px; }
        .about-title {
            margin-top: 35px;
            font-size: clamp(28px, 4.5vw, 60px);
            font-weight: 500;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: clamp(-1px, -0.3vw, -3px);
            word-break: break-word;
        }
        .about-title span { color: var(--gold); }
        .about-text {
            max-width: 650px;
            margin-top: 35px;
            color: #666;
            font-size: clamp(13px, 1.1vw, 15px);
            line-height: 2;
        }
        .contact {
            position: relative;
            padding: clamp(70px, 10vw, 150px) 0 clamp(50px, 6vw, 100px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .contact::before {
            content: "CONTACT";
            position: absolute;
            left: -20px;
            bottom: -40px;
            color: transparent;
            -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(255,255,255,.025);
            font-size: clamp(80px, 15vw, 180px);
            font-weight: 800;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .contact-layout {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 50px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .contact-title {
            margin-top: 30px;
            font-size: clamp(40px, 8vw, 110px);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: .95;
            letter-spacing: clamp(-2px, -0.5vw, -5px);
            word-break: break-word;
        }
        .contact-title span { color: var(--gold); }
        .contact-side { width: 100%; max-width: 360px; }
        .contact-description {
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            color: #666;
            font-size: clamp(13px, 1.1vw, 14px);
            line-height: 1.9;
        }
        .email {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: clamp(13px, 1.1vw, 14px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid #444;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
            word-break: break-all;
            transition: color .3s ease, border-color .3s ease;
        }
        .email:hover { color: var(--gold); border-color: var(--gold); }
        .socials {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 25px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .social {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            color: #666;
            font-size: 13px;
            transition: background .3s ease, color .3s ease, transform .3s var(--ease);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        .social:hover {
            background: var(--gold);
            color: var(--bg);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }
        .social.whatsapp:hover {
            background: #25d366;
            border-color: #25d366;
            color: #fff;
        }
        footer {
            border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
            padding: 24px 0;
        }
        .footer {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 12px;
        }
        .footer-logo {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 4px;
        }
        .footer-logo span { color: var(--gold); }
        .copyright { color: #555; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(35px);
            transition: opacity .9s var(--ease), transform .9s var(--ease);
        }
        .reveal.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        @keyframes titleReveal { to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
        @keyframes fadeUp { to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .projects { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 18px; }
            .project-card .card-image { height: 160px; }
        }
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .work-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; }
            .contact-layout { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 35px; }
            .contact-side { max-width: 100%; }
            .projects { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 15px; }
        }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .navbar { padding: 18px 16px; }
            .nav {
                display: grid;
                grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
                align-items: center;
            }
            .nav-links {
                display: none;
                position: absolute;
                top: 100%;
                left: 0;
                right: 0;
                background: rgba(7,7,7,.97);
                backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
                flex-direction: column;
                padding: 25px 20px;
                gap: 18px;
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
                box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            }
            .nav-links.show { display: flex; }
            .nav-links a { font-size: 15px; padding: 6px 0; width: 100%; text-align: center; }
            .menu-toggle { display: block; justify-self: end; }
            .hero-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 25px; }
            .hero-index { display: none; }
            .project-card .card-image { height: 140px; }
            .project-card .card-body { padding: 12px 14px 16px; }
            .card-delete-btn { opacity: 1; width: 24px; height: 24px; font-size: 10px; top: 6px; right: 6px; }
            .add-project-card { min-height: 180px; }
            .add-project-card .add-content i { font-size: 1.6rem; }
            .add-project-card .add-content span { font-size: 0.7rem; }
            .projects { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
        }
        @media (max-width: 500px) {
            body { padding: 0 6px; }
            .projects { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
            .project-card .card-image { height: 110px; }
            .project-card .card-body { padding: 8px 10px 12px; }
            .project-card .card-title { font-size: 13px; }
            .project-card .card-desc { font-size: 10px; -webkit-line-clamp: 1; }
            .project-card .card-category { font-size: 7px; padding: 1px 8px; margin-top: 4px; }
            .add-project-card { min-height: 130px; }
            .add-project-card .add-content i { font-size: 1.2rem; }
            .add-project-card .add-content span { font-size: 0.55rem; }
            .card-delete-btn { width: 20px; height: 20px; font-size: 8px; top: 4px; right: 4px; }
        }
        @media (max-width: 380px) {
            .projects { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
            .project-card .card-image { height: 150px; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="cursor"></div>
    <div class="cursor-ring"></div>
    <header class="navbar" id="navbar">
        <div class="container nav">
            <a href="#home" class="logo">{{logo_text}}<span>{{logo_accent}}</span>IR</a>
            <button class="menu-toggle" id="menuToggle" aria-label="Menu">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-bars"></i>
            </button>
            <nav>
                <ul class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
                    <li><a href="#home">{{nav_home}}</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#work">{{nav_work}}</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#about">{{nav_about}}</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#contact">{{nav_contact}}</a></li>
                </ul>
            </nav>
        </div>
    </header>
    <main>
        <section class="hero" id="home">
            <div class="hero-glow"></div>
            <div class="container hero-content">
                <div class="eyebrow hero-top"><span class="eyebrow-line"></span>{{hero_badge}}</div>
                <h1 class="hero-title">
                    <span class="hero-line"><span class="hero-word gold">{{hero_title_word1}}</span></span>
                    <span class="hero-line"><span class="hero-word">{{hero_title_word2}}</span></span>
                    <span class="hero-line"><span class="hero-word gold">{{hero_title_word3}}</span></span>
                </h1>
                <div class="hero-bottom">
                    <p class="hero-description">{{hero_desc}}</p>
                    <a href="#work" class="hero-cta">
                        {{hero_cta}}
                        <span class="cta-circle"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-down"></i></span>
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="hero-index">01 — 03</div>
        </section>
        <section class="work" id="work">
            <div class="container">
                <div class="work-header reveal">
                    <div><div class="eyebrow"><span class="eyebrow-line"></span>{{work_badge}}</div></div>
                    <div>
                        <h2 class="work-title">
                            {{work_title}}<br>
                            <span class="outline">{{work_title_highlight}}</span>
                        </h2>
                        <p class="work-description">{{work_desc}}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="projects" id="projectsContainer">
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
        <section class="about" id="about">
            <div class="container">
                <div class="about-content reveal">
                    <div class="eyebrow"><span class="eyebrow-line"></span>{{about_badge}}</div>
                    <h2 class="about-title">
                        {{about_title}}<br>
                        {{about_title2}}
                    </h2>
                    <p class="about-text">{{about_desc}}</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
        <section class="contact" id="contact">
            <div class="container">
                <div class="contact-layout">
                    <div class="reveal">
                        <div class="eyebrow"><span class="eyebrow-line"></span>{{contact_badge}}</div>
                        <h2 class="contact-title">
                            {{contact_title}}<br>
                            {{contact_title2}}
                        </h2>
                    </div>
                    <div class="contact-side reveal">
                        <p class="contact-description">{{contact_desc}}</p>
                        <a href="mailto:{{contact_email}}" class="email">
                            {{contact_email}}
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
                        </a>
                        <div class="socials">
                            <a href="{{social_instagram}}" class="social" target="_blank" aria-label="Instagram">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-instagram"></i>
                            </a>
                            <a href="{{social_linkedin}}" class="social" target="_blank" aria-label="LinkedIn">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-linkedin-in"></i>
                            </a>
                            <a href="{{social_github}}" class="social" target="_blank" aria-label="GitHub">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i>
                            </a>
                            <a href="https://wa.me/{{whatsapp_number}}" class="social whatsapp" target="_blank" aria-label="WhatsApp">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i>
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
    </main>
    <footer>
        <div class="container footer">
            <div class="footer-logo">{{logo_text}}<span>{{logo_accent}}</span>IR</div>
            <div class="copyright">{{footer_text}}</div>
        </div>
    </footer>
    <script>
        const navbar = document.getElementById("navbar");
        window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
            navbar.classList.toggle("scrolled", window.scrollY > 40);
        });
        const menuToggle = document.getElementById("menuToggle");
        const navLinks = document.getElementById("navLinks");
        menuToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
            navLinks.classList.toggle("show");
            const icon = menuToggle.querySelector("i");
            icon.classList.toggle("fa-bars");
            icon.classList.toggle("fa-xmark");
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".nav-links a").forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener("click", () => {
                navLinks.classList.remove("show");
                const icon = menuToggle.querySelector("i");
                icon.classList.add("fa-bars");
                icon.classList.remove("fa-xmark");
            });
        });
        document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            if (!e.target.closest(".navbar")) {
                navLinks.classList.remove("show");
                const icon = menuToggle.querySelector("i");
                icon.classList.add("fa-bars");
                icon.classList.remove("fa-xmark");
            }
        });
        const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
            entries => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add("show");
                        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                    }
                });
            },
            { threshold: .12 }
        );
        revealElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
        const cursor = document.querySelector(".cursor");
        const cursorRing = document.querySelector(".cursor-ring");
        let mouseX = 0,
            mouseY = 0,
            ringX = 0,
            ringY = 0;
        document.addEventListener("mousemove", event => {
            mouseX = event.clientX;
            mouseY = event.clientY;
            cursor.style.left = mouseX + "px";
            cursor.style.top = mouseY + "px";
        });
        function animateCursor() {
            ringX += (mouseX - ringX) * .14;
            ringY += (mouseY - ringY) * .14;
            cursor.style.display = "block";
            cursorRing.style.display = "block";
            cursorRing.style.left = ringX + "px";
            cursorRing.style.top = ringY + "px";
            requestAnimationFrame(animateCursor);
        }
        if (window.matchMedia("(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)").matches) {
            animateCursor();
        }
        document.querySelectorAll("a, button").forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => document.body.classList.add("cursor-hover"));
            el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => document.body.classList.remove("cursor-hover"));
        });
        document.querySelectorAll(".eyebrow, .eyebrow-line, .hero-title, .hero-description, .hero-cta, .work-title, .work-description, .project-name, .project-category, .about-title, .about-text, .contact-title, .contact-description, .email, .footer-logo, .copyright, .nav-links a, .logo").forEach(el => {
            el.setAttribute("data-editable", "true");
        });
        console.log("✅ NOIR Smart Template loaded successfully!");
    </script>
</body>
</html>
